summary: BidBlitz Charge App MVP Testing PASSED - All 7 features tested successfully. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in invoice save endpoint. Backend APIs (dashboard, warranty registration, invoice save) work correctly. Frontend UI loads without blank screen, all forms functional, navigation from /all-services works.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in /api/charge-app/invoices/save - added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one to prevent TypeError
ChargeAppPage.jsx: All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
AllServicesPage.jsx: BidBlitz Charge correctly added to 'Buchen & Reservieren' category with route /charge-app
charge_app.py: Proper validation for required fields (product_name, serial_number for warranty; invoice_number, merchant_name for invoice)
charge_app.py: Duplicate detection works correctly for both warranties and invoices
seed_data_creation: Test warranties and invoices created during testing with TEST- prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: BidBlitz Charge App is fully functional. Backend APIs at /api/charge-app/* work correctly. Frontend page at /charge-app loads without issues. Navigation from /all-services works. All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing.

charge_app_page_loads.verification: Page loads at /charge-app without blank screen or crash

warranty_registration.verification: Customer can register warranty with product name, serial number, optional merchant/invoice data. Saved warranty appears in list.

invoice_save.verification: Customer can save invoice with invoice number, merchant name, amount. Saved invoice appears in list.

loyalty_data_display.verification: Loyalty data (coins, level, cashback, progress) displayed from existing loyalty system

offers_and_merchant_finder.verification: Promotional offers displayed, merchant finder list shown with search functionality

all_services_navigation.verification: BidBlitz Charge entry reachable from /all-services and navigates correctly to /charge-app

backend_apis.verification: All 3 APIs work for authenticated customer session

test_scope: BidBlitz Charge App MVP - Backend + Frontend
